content.title: Printed QR code bench labels
content.statement: The board chose printed QR code labels for every bench, starting at Paul's greenhouse in June.
content.context: Aisha showed the label layout: the bench number in large type above a QR code.
content.rationale: Half of growers' phones cannot read NFC, and a printed QR label costs a few cents.

sources.excerpt: Decision: the board chose printed QR code labels for every bench, starting at Paul's greenhouse in June.
Aisha showed the label layout: the bench number in large type above a QR code.
The QR code labels for every bench stay the plan.
Aisha explained why the board picked QR codes in May instead of NFC tags:
half of the growers' phones cannot read NFC, and a printed QR label costs a few cents.
